title: 398. Random Pick Index

examples.explanation: Valid indexes are 2, 3 and 4. The exact sequence varies; every returned index must hold target 3.
Only index 0 holds the value 1, so every pick must return 0.
All four indexes are valid; over a long trace each one must be able to appear.

hints: Store the indexes for each value, or use reservoir sampling while scanning nums for a target.
Every index whose value equals target must have the same chance of being returned.
The judge runs long traces and requires every valid index to appear; always returning the first match fails.
